description: ScalableTestGrids is a Modelica library of synthetic large power-system test cases developed by RTE with Dynamica. The README explains how two integer parameters scale an extra-high-voltage grid. Generator and load nodes connect through transformers and high-voltage lines, and a specified load reduction triggers frequency-control and inter-area transients. Users set the two scale factors and run the Modelica cases; outputs are simulated dynamic electrical responses and tool-performance measurements. The networks are synthetic, not mapped to an actual country. Repository metadata and the README state MPL-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that these structured grids are designed to test simulation-tool performance, so their topology and disturbances do not represent the full diversity of operational transmission networks. The cases can benchmark large-grid solvers before using them for infrastructure resilience studies. They draw components from the PowerGrids library but are a separately published benchmark resource. No model code or generated case was downloaded. The related platform-openmodelica catalogue record describes a Modelica simulation environment; G7 did not test these cases in it.
inputs: Two grid scale parameters and disturbance settings
name: ScalableTestGrids Modelica power-system benchmarks
notes: G7 G7-1968. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Synthetic power-system transient and solver benchmark results
